name: The Glass Reach
summary: The southeastern sands where the Sundering's heat ran the desert to glass: dune-seas of green and smoke-grey glass over buried Concord cities. The Shard Cities — excavation city-states — dig, scaffold, and sell what they find; the Dhar Roads carry it north.

geography.character: glass-dune seas that chime in wind; sand-blowne towers of buried cities breaking the surface like ribs

notable_sites.name: The Mouth Cities
notable_sites.note: Shard City excavations built into the exposed gate-mouths of buried Concord cities; the diggers live inside their ancestors' doorways.

notable_sites.name: The Chimeway
notable_sites.note: A glassed Concord boulevard running half a mile underground between two digs; lantern-lit toll-road, privately held, frequently disputed.

lore_notes: 'The deserts ran with glass' in the Year of Ashfall; the Reach is that sentence made landscape.
Karvess — the glass kingdom vitrified by the Rent — lies at the Reach's northern edge; its weathering glass feeds the dunes.
The Glimmer flickers like heat-haze here: hedge-craft works oddly, echo-touched items sing on windy nights.
adventure_hooks: A dig breaks into a chamber still holding air from before the Sundering; what exhaled out has not been identified.
The Shard Cities hire outsiders for a salvage race after a sandstorm exposes a new tower-top.
